title: Nectarous Cheesy Venezuelan Beef Wrap
description: A citrusy, cheese-pulled wrap featuring tender feather blade beef, bright orange-lime sauce, and melted queso fresco for a light Venezuelan-inspired lunch.
instructions: Heat the lazy-susan-spinner on medium and drizzle olive oil over the bottom.
Add sliced beef, sprinkle salt and pepper, and sauté until browned, about 4 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for an additional minute until fragrant.
Pour in the orange juice and lime juice, add zest, and let the mixture simmer for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or the lazy-susan-spinner until pliable.
Spoon the beef mixture onto each tortilla, top with crumbled queso fresco and fresh cilantro.
Add avocado slices if using, then roll the tortillas tightly and place back in the lazy-susan-spinner.
Cook the wrapped tacos for 8 minutes to meld flavors, then serve hot.
